Embiid (PHI) firms up over his right leg in Eason's (HOU) path prior to the contact.

events.verdict: Embiid (PHI) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Rockets.
Sheppard (HOU) inbounds the ball while remaining within his designated throw in location.
Edgecombe (PHI) and Thompson (HOU) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
George (PHI) deflects the ball away from Sengun (HOU).
Sheppard (HOU) grazes Maxey's (PHI) left arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Embiid (PHI) jumps alongside Sheppard's (HOU) path as he defends the shot attempt.
George (PHI) raises his hand towards the ball and the contact with Sengun's (HOU) arm is marginal.
Embiid (PHI) maintains verticality as he and Smith Jr. (HOU) meet at the same spot in the air.
Smith Jr. (HOU) establishes himself in Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) path prior to the contact.
Durant (HOU) applies his hand to Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) side and immediately removes his hand as he begins his drive.
Maxey (PHI) wraps his arm around Durant's (HOU) side and initiates contact that affects his SQBR.
Maxey (PHI) and Thompson (HOU) come together at the same spot and incidental foot to foot contact occurs off-ball.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) legally contests Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Durant (HOU) blocks Maxey's (PHI) shot attempt after the ball makes contact with the backboard and has a chance to score.
Play is stopped due to an inadvertent whistle.  After discussion, it is determined that neither team had possession of the ball and play resumes with a jump ball at center circle.
Thompson (HOU) initiates contact with Embiid's (PHI) arm, and the contact occurs prior to the start of Embiid's upward shooting motion.
Sengun (HOU) avoids making contact with Maxey's (PHI) arm as he defends the shot attempt.

George (PHI) blocks Sengun's (HOU) shot attempt.  The ensuing contact to Sengun's head that occurs after the shot is blocked is considered marginal.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Smith Jr. (HOU) maintains verticality as he defends Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) establishes himself in Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) path prior to the contact.
Edgecombe (PHI) moves alongside Durant's (HOU) path as he defends the shot attempt.
George (PHI) extends his arm into Sengun (HOU) and delivers contact that affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) dislodges the ball from Durant (HOU).
Durant (HOU) extends his arms into Edgecombe (PHI) and delivers contact that affects his ability to defend.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Rockets.

Sengun (HOU) and Smith Jr. (HOU) both legally contest Edgecombe's (PHI) shot attempt. Edgecombe loses control of the ball on his own, and any ensuing contact that occurs after he's no longer in control of the ball is incidental.
Maxey (PHI) legally contests Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Eason (HOU) deflects the ball away from Oubre Jr. (PHI) as they pursue the rebound.
Edgecombe (PHI) moves laterally into Durant's (HOU) path and initiates contact as he defends the shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
Maxey (PHI) avoids making contact with Thompson (HOU), who loses control of the ball on his own as he spins away from Maxey.
Edgecombe (PHI) deflects the ball away from Thompson (HOU).
Smith Jr. (HOU) grazes Embiid's (PHI) arm after he has released the pass.
The ball is deflected by George (PHI) and Eason (HOU) legally gains control of the ball in the backcourt.
